claims: The Artemis II mission successfully launched on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission launched from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The Artemis II mission is the first crewed mission to the Moon since 1972.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission.
The Artemis II mission carries four astronauts.
The Artemis II mission involves a journey around the Moon and back.
The Artemis II mission uses the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The Artemis II mission uses the Orion capsule.
